question: When a caller-supplied trusted inline Pi extension factory fails to initialize, does the Vercel AI SDK Pi harness surface that failure instead of quietly starting without the extension?

sources.name: Vercel AI SDK harness-pi inline extension implementation
sources.claim: The harness reloads inline extension factories, then later destructures only session from Pi createAgentSession and does not inspect resourceLoader extension errors.

sources.name: Pi DefaultResourceLoader
sources.claim: Inline factory exceptions are caught and retained in extensionsResult.errors while loading continues with the successful extension subset.

sources.name: Pi createAgentSession and AgentSession runtime
sources.claim: createAgentSession returns extensionsResult to the caller; AgentSession builds its extension runner from extensions/runtime and does not consume extensionsResult.errors.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: The loader records a factory failure while Pi can still construct a session from zero successfully loaded extensions.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: A factory exception is a diagnostic result, not an automatic Pi startup exception.

distinguishing_outcomes.observation: The modeled current Vercel handoff returns the session while dropping the extension diagnostic carrier.
distinguishing_outcomes.interpretation: The harness can start without an explicitly requested trusted extension and without surfacing why it is absent.

stop_condition: Stop after source, dependency contract, one negative-control model, and a latest-main target-native test distinguish surfaced failure from silent partial startup.
